reviews.title: Sweet Deal for my Snow White PC Build!
reviews.comment:
Perfect, New Condition. Great Deal, Snagged at a Low Price.
Came with everything you need to install and plug in your set up, The Braided wire covering on the provided white wiring could have been put on better which are glued and cannot be adjusted to bring it closer to the connector to hide the individual wires. Wish it did come with Second 2x4 Pin CPU Wire for Overclocking.
reviews.author: SnowWhite

reviews.title: Surprisingly compact for the size.
reviews.comment:
I was delighted to discover how much smaller this power supply was than I had envisioned. 
It is well-designed and works perfectly.
The cables supplied with it are white and nicely wrapped for airflow.
